subject: Case discovery roundtable — scheduling and recording consent
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@helixhealth.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Case discovery roundtable — scheduling and recording consent

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for agreeing to help Helix Health’s story come to life. We’d love to run a short discovery roundtable with product and customer success leads so we can capture the impact data and a few quotes for a case study (15–25 minutes).

Proposed windows next week (PT):
- Tue 1/19: 10:00–10:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Wed 1/20: 09:00–09:30 or 13:30–14:00

Agenda (high level):
- Quick intros (3m)
- Outcomes and metrics Helix saw with Redwood (8–10m)
- Implementation highlights + concerns (5m)
- Approvals & next steps for review/recording consent (2–5m)

One note on logistics: we typically record these calls so our marketing team can transcribe and pull verbatim quotes. If you or anyone on your side prefers not to be recorded, we can take notes and only request written approvals for any quotes.

If any of those times work, tell me who will join from your side and which slot you prefer and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai]

[Attachment: draft_agenda_case_discovery.docx (document)]

From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@helixhealth.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:04:15 -0800
Subject: Re: Case discovery roundtable — scheduling and recording consent

Hi Rishi —

Thanks — Tue 1/19 at 10:00 PT works for us. Attending from Helix: Myself (Director of Product), Tom Barrett (Head of Analytics), and Priya Singh (Implementation Lead).

Recording is fine — we just need to confirm that any direct quotes will be shared for approval before publication. Also, can you include a very short list of questions in the agenda so Priya can pre-prepare any implementation details?

— Elena
Elena Gomez
Director of Product, Helix Health
elena.gomez@helixhealth.io

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@helixhealth.io>, Tom Barrett <tom.barrett@helixhealth.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:27:32 -0800
Subject: Re: Case discovery roundtable — scheduling and recording consent

Perfect — 10:00–10:25 PT on Tue 1/19 is locked. Adding Monica (Customer Success) and Laura (Marketing) so they can join; Monica will lead the call and Laura will take notes for the case write-up.

Attached is a short question set / draft agenda based on Elena’s ask. Quick highlights:
- Metrics we’ll ask for (e.g., latency improvements, cost per inference delta, developer velocity signal)
- Implementation timeline and one or two technical decisions you found important
- Any third-party compliance notes (if relevant)

Please review the attached and tell me if you’d like any changes; happy to tighten it up.

I’ll send an invite to the confirmed attendees now.

Regards,
Rishi

[Attachment: redwood_case_consent.txt (text)]

From: Tom Barrett <tom.barrett@helixhealth.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@helixhealth.io>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 08:12:07 -0800
Subject: Re: Case discovery roundtable — scheduling and recording consent

Thanks, Rishi — confirmed for 10:00 PT. Quick note on attendees: Priya had a calendar conflict and will join for the first 10 minutes only; Jack Rivera (Data Ops) will join in her place for implementation details.

Agenda looks good. One small request: can we add a 60-second callout where we confirm the exact timeframe/data windows you’ll need for metrics (e.g., date ranges, pre/post comparison windows)? That will help us pull the right dashboards beforehand.

Recording consent: fine with recording. We also confirm that any quotes are approved by Helix prior to publication.

— Tom

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@helixhealth.io>, Tom Barrett <tom.barrett@helixhealth.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 10:22:11 -0800
Subject: Re: Case discovery roundtable — scheduling and recording consent

Great — thanks everyone. Calendar invite and an updated agenda with the metrics callout are attached.

Quick logistics recap:
- Tue 1/19, 10:00–10:25 PT (Zoom) — invite attached/emailed to attendees
- Recording enabled; Redwood marketing will transcribe and share excerpts. Helix will review and approve any quotes before publication.
- Requested artifacts: a screenshot of the dashboard for the primary metric and the deployment dates for the pre/post windows (Tom/Jack/Priya — if you can surface those during the call or drop them in the shared Drive link afterwards, that would be ideal).

Links: agenda doc + HQ drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-agenda-doc-12345
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/987654321

Thanks — looking forward to the discussion.

Best,
Rishi
